evidence.quote: We propose a $32 million class fund, distributed automatically using Brightline’s records. Attorneys’ fees and expenses would be paid separately, subject to court approval; any amount not awarded would go to the class.
We proposed class relief and fees together; it would be inaccurate to say fees were discussed only after class relief was agreed.

summary: Class counsel proposed class relief and attorneys’ fees together in the first and only round, before any final settlement was accepted. The transcript does not show an explicit tradeoff between fees and class relief, plaintiff counsel prioritizing firm economics over the class, defense leveraging fee interests, or materially misleading statements in the court declaration.
